Name: Stardew Dualscreen Mod
Author: ProfMags
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
A dual-screen mod for Stardew Valley designed for Android dual-screen handhelds. The mod works alongside the latest version of SMAPI and Stardew Valley, bringing useful game information and features to your second screen.

Setup is simple: add the mod to your SMAPI Mods folder, launch Stardew Valley, then open the Dual Screen app on your bottom display. Once your game is loaded, the mod will connect and start working automatically.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Install the game mod into your SMAPI Mods folder, launch Stardew Valley, and load your save. Once you’re in game, open the Android app on your bottom screen and the dual screen mod will start working automatically.
The Android app can be found here:
[url=https://github.com/JoeCorrell/AYN-Thor-Dualscreen-Mods]https://github.com/JoeCorrell/AYN-Thor-Dualscreen-Mods[/url]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Main features:[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Interactive hotbar and backpack with support for all 3 inventory rows[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Swap between hotbar and backpack rows using L and R[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Full touchscreen support on the second screen[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Overhauled map with useful information and tracking[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Journal with active quests, descriptions, objectives, and rewards[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Relationship and villager tracking[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Track whether you’ve talked to each villager today[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Track gifts given to villagers[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Community Center bundle tracking[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]See which items are still needed for each bundle[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]See when you already have a required bundle item in your inventory[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Full crafting interface with recipes, ingredients, and requirements[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Farm tracking for machines that are ready to collect[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Track animals that need attention[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Track trees and other farm resources that are ready[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Player stats and skill information[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Active buffs and status effects[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Current day, season, time, and gold display[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Weather information[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Tool information, including watering can water level[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Weapon information and cooldown tracking[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Moves useful HUD information to the second screen, freeing up space on the main display[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Designed specifically for dual screen Android handhelds[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Runs alongside Stardew Valley using SMAPI[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Automatically connects to the Android dual screen app after loading your save[/color]

Manifest.Name: Stardew Valley Dual Screen Mod
Manifest.Description: Adds a live, touch-friendly Stardew Valley companion UI for WEMU's lower screen, including backpack, crafting, map, journal, relationships, farm status, bundles, calendar and settings.
Manifest.Author: Profmags
